correctness.rationale: The exact inverse-Gaussian conjugation of the Gaussian adjoint reduces singular values to symmetric tensor powers of e^{tB}; second quantization gives exp(pt tr B) product(1-sigma_i(t)^p)^-1. The dissipative Gramian W_t=I-e^{tB^T}e^{tB}=integral_0^t e^{sB^T}Qe^{sB} ds is strictly positive exactly for a full Kalman flag; a missing direction leaves tensor powers with singular value one, so no compactness. Orthogonal filtration projections have first coefficients s^k C_k, yielding D_t^-1 W_t D_t^-1 -> positive G, det W_t ~ det G t^K. Positivity follows from independent polynomial coefficients and full row ranks. Replacement 1-sigma^p ~ p(1-sigma^2)/2 yields the coefficient. Nonincreasing Kalman increments and delayed one-dimensional levels give sharp upper bound; explicit dissipative skew-chain B=J_m + scalar blocks gives extremal m=d-r+1, its signed Hilbert determinant gives factorial coefficient. Independently recomputed exact rank-one d=3 determinant(G)=1/1080 and S1 leading 8640; inspected source CHECK.py exact-rational checker through m=8 but did not treat it as a universal proof.
residual_risks: The positive-definite normalization and finite-dimensional matrix assumptions are essential; the result makes no assertion for general Lq, non-Gaussian or infinite-dimensional semigroups.
